This veterinary center has been my lifesaver! The receptionists are always available and ready to answer any questions. The office is always well-organized, with appointments at various times, without endless waits. Everything is always impeccably clean and air-conditioned. The doctor is a saint. Honest, attentive, professional, and above all, human. Thank you so much for your service!

My dog ​​had a genetic cataract that was almost inoperable. I took him to this center, and thanks to their professionalism, care, and profound compassion, he regained perfect vision. The work of Dr. Barbi and Dr. Borgia was crucial. My experience was beyond excellent.

I took my Pitbull to this clinic for a visit and couldn't be more satisfied. Often, with breeds like mine, one fears prejudice or rigidity, but instead we found an extraordinary environment here.
The staff proved not only incredibly professional and knowledgeable, but above all, incredibly empathetic. They approached my dog ​​with unique kindness and calm, immediately putting him at ease. The facility is clean, the expertise is top-notch, and the attention to the human and psychological aspects of dogs is truly rare.
This will definitely become our go-to place.

The Ivet Center is incredible! I have no other words to describe my experience. The center is an example of professionalism, expertise, innovation, kindness, and empathy. I took my 8-year-old dog for a routine ultrasound. When he picked up the dog, Dr. Vellotti recognized a growth that immediately raised his suspicions. Within minutes, he performed a cytology scan and identified a tumor. The tumor was removed at the center in just three days after a thorough oncology/surgical examination. The dog's anesthesia was impeccable; my dog ​​walked out on his own two feet. We are now awaiting the histology report. I have already been explained the possible scenarios and treatment options. In this difficult situation, I couldn't have hoped for anything better.
Very kind and professional. It was a blessing to find this center. They helped us through a very difficult time with our puppy and saved her. Thank you.

I had already been to this center three years ago for a specialist eye exam for my elderly cat, and even then I was able to experience the humanity of the entire staff. Years later, I returned, and despite the tragic outcome for my cat, I found the doctors to be incredibly empathetic. Thank you for all the support.

We can never thank the doctor and his entire staff enough for the professionalism, expertise, and compassion they showed our poodle, Gasgas.
The surgery on his hind leg was performed with great care and precision, and from the very first moment we felt welcomed, listened to, and reassured. Seeing Gasgas recover so well was confirmation that we had entrusted ourselves to a truly exceptional veterinarian.
In addition to his high level of professionalism, we appreciated his availability, kindness, and genuine love for animals. It's rare to find a doctor who combines technical expertise and empathy so effortlessly.
We recommend this veterinarian to anyone wishing to entrust their four-legged friend to safe hands. Thank you so much for everything you've done for our Gasgas!

ACL surgery for my little dog. Efficient, thorough, and above all, clear in providing all the necessary pre- and post-op information. A week after surgery, the little one is recovering, and the center is always available for any questions or concerns.
Thank you ☺️

After visiting three different vets, all of whom, for one reason or another, didn't work out, I finally found the perfect solution. The reception in the waiting room by the secretary, Manuela, was very pleasant. There are several vets with different specialties, all very professional, competent, and clear in their explanations. Highly recommended.
Kindness and maximum availability, we took our Yuri to Dr. Carolina who was prompt and professional in helping our little dog. Thank you so much ❤️

I was seemingly calm when I entered this wonderful center, filled with humility, professionalism, and high levels of expertise, along with a great deal of humanity.
My elderly Cavalier King Charles Spaniel was no longer eating and has heart problems.
I can say that thanks to these angels, my dog ​​not only appears to have more energy and vitality, but we've recognized ourselves as our little girl again.
We will carefully follow the protocols, and I'm sure she will remain with us for a long time to come.
Thank you, thank you, thank you to all the staff.
I absolutely recommend this center, and I'm sure you'll find a smile and hope for your four-legged friends again.
Seeing is believing!

I can only congratulate you, excellent professionals.
My 15-year-old Cavalier Desy was already thought to be dead, but thanks to this wonderful center, my little girl is regaining the strength she'd lost; she's reborn. ❤️ Thank you, thank you, thank you.
I absolutely recommend it!

Excellent facility with an equally fantastic doctor!!
Dr. Leonardo Barbi operated on our dog Fiamma for a corneal ulcer. He was extremely professional, helpful, and kind, completely resolving the problem with her eye. We thank him very much.
Thank you 😊 …

Yesterday for the first time I called your office and you were immediately available. I thank Dr. Diletta Di Lorenzo. She treated my dog ​​with love and patience. What impressed me even more was the cleanliness. Thanks again.
Very good
Professionalism and courtesy to the highest degree. Kudos to the staff.
Thanks to Dr. Leonardo Barbi for treating my dog's eyesight. He was kind, affectionate, and above all, excellent at his job! I recommend him to everyone.

An excellent team! At this center, professionalism and empathy go hand in hand; Dr. Vellotti, along with Dr. Barbi, are providing unwavering support to my Maltese dog Trilli, and therefore me, throughout this long pre- and post-surgery cataract journey. From the beginning, with clarity and kindness, they gave me the opportunity to face this challenging experience with full awareness. Entrust your furry friends to them with confidence!

Meticulous, attentive, and punctual! I went to Dr. Barbi for an eye exam for my dog ​​and found a truly expert and passionate professional who overlooked every detail, not just in terms of her eyes. A competent, compassionate, and helpful doctor. Tata and I thank him from the bottom of our hearts!
Dr. Barbi promptly treated a rather serious corneal ulcer in my dog, resolving the problem with great professionalism and expertise.
Dr. Barbi, 0 stars. 100 euros for a 15-minute visit. Arrogant, just there to work without passion.
